Senior React Native Developer, Zoho — Sep 2017 - Present
Led delivery of multiple consumer and internal mobile apps built with TypeScript and React Native. Implemented app-wide state management using Redux, migrating legacy JavaScript modules to TS and introducing strict typing to reduce runtime defects. Optimized bundle size and startup time, improving cold start by 35% and reducing crash rate through better error boundaries and disciplined Git branching. Coordinated with backend and QA to ship biweekly releases via CI, integrated feature flags to run A/B experiments and rolled out progressive updates to 100k+ active users.

Mobile Engineer, Tata Consultancy Services — Jun 2014 - Aug 2017
Developed cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and Expo for enterprise clients, building reusable components and shared modules. Managed state with Redux and wrote JavaScript utilities for API handling and offline caching, improving data sync reliability by measurable margins in field deployments. Used Git for source control across distributed teams and contributed to build and deployment scripts to streamline Expo-based releases.

Skills: React Native, TS, Redux, JavaScript, Expo, Git

Education: B.Tech, Computer Engineering, MPSTME NMIMS
